pulls.title: Apply discount per line to match invoices
pulls.author: fede
pulls.body:
Closes #40.

Billing applies the discount to each line and rounds each line to the cent; checkout applied it once to the subtotal, so the two disagree by a cent on some orders. `lineTotal` now takes the discount and rounds per line, and `orderTotal` sums the discounted lines.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.body: Matches what billing does. LGTM once it's mergeable.

pulls.title: Reject quantities below 1
pulls.author: bruno
pulls.body:
Fixes #44.

`lineTotal` throws a `RangeError` for any quantity that isn't a whole number of at least 1, before computing anything, so a bad quantity can never reach the payment service.

issues.title: Checkout total is a cent off the invoice
issues.author: carla
issues.body: Three items at $3.33 with the 10% loyalty discount: checkout shows $8.99, the invoice says $9.00. Billing discounts and rounds every line; checkout discounts the subtotal. Checkout has to match the invoice, customers are filing tickets about it.

issues.title: Negative quantity creates a refund at checkout
issues.author: bruno
issues.body: POSTing a cart line with qty -1 gives a negative line total, and the payment service treats a negative charge as a refund. qty 1.5 and qty 0 are accepted too. Quantities must be whole numbers >= 1; reject anything else in the cart before any money math.
